text: Treasury raised its buyback operation to $6B from the normal $2B and set future operations at no less than $4B. The program covers 10- and 20-year securities. The 10-year yield reached 4.841%, while 20- and 30-year yields exceeded 5.3%.

meta.note: The stated liquidity function coexists with market debate over the operation's relationship to yield levels.

text: The 10-year Treasury yield reached its highest level since November 2023 and traded at 4.824%, while the 30-year reached 5.28% and the 2-year 4.417%. Treasury's anounced $6B long-duration debt buyback is triple its normal operation.

meta.note: This overlaps the 1:30 event but isolates the yield configuration following the announced buyback size.

text: Apple introduced iPhone 18 Pro, the foldable iPhone Duo, AI-enabled Siri and new A20 Pro and C2 chips. The lineup extends iPhone into foldables and local AI processing while increasing Apple-designed control over compute and cellular components.

meta.note: The launch combines multiple products, but all converge on the iPhone platform architecture.
